quarterly_data.quarter: Digital Realty Bank of America conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Sadler gave the pricing of the Blackstone JV buy-in: the December 2023 deal 'ultimately became an $8 billion JV with Blackstone to develop hyperscale data centers', and a few months ago Digital Realty 'bought in the remaining 64% interest that they owned in these three assets, cost us about $5 billion at just over a 6.5% cap rate', for AA- rated credit with 15 year leases. The assets were never meant to stay in the development JV. Digital Realty is happy to hold them on balance sheet, they could later feed its strategic private capital business, and more recapitalizations like this are likely.
quarterly_data.figure: $8 billion JV with Blackstone; remaining 64% interest bought for about $5 billion at just over a 6.5% cap rate
